## APPLE, PECAN, SPICE, & EVERYTHING NICE


There’s something about crisp autumn air that puts us in the mood for dessert. Maybe it’s the leaves turning, maybe it’s the countdown to Thanksgiving. Either way, fall doesn’t feel official until you’ve had a slice of apple pie, pecan pie, or a warm-spiced cake.


America’s bakeries have been perfecting fall flavors for generations, from Wisconsin apple country to New Orleans’ Garden District to Appalachian mountain kitchens.


The best fall desserts fall into seven categories: apple pies, apple cakes and pastries, pecan pies, sweet potato desserts, Southern layer cakes, cozy fall treats, and pumpkin desserts. Grab a fork and dig in.


[Order Fall Desserts on Goldbelly](https://www.goldbelly.com/collections/fall-desserts)


## **What Are The Best Flavors For Fall Cakes?**


The best fall desserts lean on warming spices like cinnamon, nutmeg, clove, ginger, cardamom, and allspice, the blend known as pumpkin spice or apple spice. Beyond spice, the classic fall flavors include:


- Apple and caramel apple
- Pecan and praline
- Sweet potato
- Maple
- Cinnamon walnut
- Pumpkin


## **Apple Pies**


Fall is peak apple season, and nothing says autumn like a towering[apple pie](https://www.goldbelly.com/foods/apple-pies) with a golden crust.


### **** **The Elegant Farmer’s Apple Pie Baked in a Paper Bag®**


The Elegant Farmer was founded in 1946 as a small, family-run dairy farm in Wisconsin. Today it’s one of the Midwest’s most beloved markets and bakeries, and it’s most famous for its signature Apple Pie Baked in a Paper Bag®. The pie is stuffed with steamed, juicy Ida Red apples. Baking it in a paper bag gives it a uniquely crunchy, sugar cookie-like top crust and a light, flaky bottom crust.


**[Apple Pie Baked in a Paper Bag® >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/the-elegant-farmer/original-apple-pie-baked-in-a-paper-bag)**


### **** **Blue Owl Bakery’s Levee High Caramel Pecan Apple Pie**


The pie that landed on Oprah’s Favorite Things comes from Kimmswick, Missouri. Mary Hostetter created the Levee High in 1993 to honor the volunteers who held back the Great Flood. Eighteen hand-peeled Golden Delicious apples are mounded sky-high in a scratch crust, then covered in caramel and pecans. Each pie weighs about ten pounds and bakes up hot in your own oven.


**[Levee High Caramel Pecan Apple Pie >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/blue-owl-bakery/levee-high-caramel-pecan-apple-pie)**


## **Apple Cakes & Pastries**


When pie isn’t enough, fall apples go into bundts, kringles, and more.


### **** **Red Truck Bakery’s Shenandoah Apple Cake**


Red Truck Bakery in Marshall, Virginia, sources apples from local orchards throughout the region, including the Shenandoah Valley. This 9-inch bundt-style cake is made with fresh apples and apple cider, a hint of cinnamon, and a maple glaze. Saveur magazine singled it out as a can’t-miss seasonal treat. It’s available only September through December.


**[Shenandoah Apple Cake >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/red-truck-bakery/shenandoah-apple-cake)**


### **O and H Danish Bakery’s Apple Kringle**


O&H Danish Bakery was started by Danish immigrant Christian Olesen in Racine, Wisconsin, in 1949, and it’s still going strong, today run by the fourth generation. The bakery is most famous for its kringle, a traditional ring-shaped filled Danish pastry. Their classic Apple Kringle fills this traditional flaky, buttery pastry with apples, and it’s sprinkled lightly with cinnamon and a fabulous spiced sauce.


**[Apple Kringle >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/oandh-danish-bakery/121-apple-kringle)**


## **Pecan Pies**


Rich, sticky[pecan pie](https://www.goldbelly.com/foods/pecan-pies) is a fall and Thanksgiving essential, especially in the South.


### **** **Commander’s Palace’s Pecan Pie**


Commander’s Palace has been serving its famous Haute Creole cuisine in New Orleans’ Garden District since 1893. Its Pecan Pie has a sticky filling in a crust of precise texture and thickness, a nod to early recipes that used local sugarcane syrup or molasses.


**[Pecan Pie >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/commanders-palace/pecan-pie)**


### **** **Michele’s Pies’ Chocolate Pecan Bourbon Pie**


Every pie at Michele’s Pies is made by hand at Michele Stuart’s pie shop in Norwalk, Connecticut. Since opening in 2007, the shop has won 33 National Pie Championship awards, and this pie was the first. A flaky crust holds a bourbon chocolate layer on the bottom and a crunchy topping of chopped pecans and semi-sweet chocolate chips.


**[Chocolate Pecan Bourbon Pie >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/micheles-pies/15538-chocolate-pecan-bourbon)**


## **Sweet Potato Desserts**


Sweet potato brings a velvety, earthy sweetness to fall baking and a deep Southern tradition.


### **Nikki J’s Cakes’ Sweet Potato Thang**


It’s not a sweet potato pie. It’s Nikki J’s Sweet Potato Thang, from Rowlett, Texas. A velvety sweet potato filling sits on a graham cracker crust, with a silky texture and just a hint of pure vanilla.


**[Sweet Potato Thang >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/nikki-js-cakes/sweet-potato-thang)**


### **Southern Girl Desserts’ GIANT Sweet Potato Pound Cake**


Catarah Coleman and Shoneji Robison were both born and raised in Florida. In 2007 they founded Southern Girl Desserts to bring some Southern savvy to Los Angeles, with nostalgic recipes from their grandmothers. This massive pound cake is loaded with sweet potato, cinnamon, and nutmeg, and topped with cream cheese frosting.


**[GIANT Sweet Potato Pound Cake >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/southern-girl-desserts/sweet-potato-pound-cake)**


## **Southern Layer Cakes**


Layer upon layer of fall flavor, straight from Southern kitchens.


### **The Village Bakery’s Mountain Apple Stack Cake**


The Mountain Apple Stack Cake is an Appalachian tradition that has been served at weddings for generations. Using an old family recipe, the Village Bakery in Knoxville uses Tennessee green apples from orchards a few miles from the Smoky Mountains. The apples are hand-peeled, cooked down into apple butter, spiced, and spread between the layers of cake.


**[Tennessee Mountain Apple Stack Cake >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/the-village-bakery/15326-mountain-apple-stack-cake)**


### **Savannah Candy Kitchen’s Praline Layer Cake**


Stan Strickland opened Savannah’s Candy Kitchen on Savannah’s River Street more than 30 years ago. This three-layer cake is made from scratch, with the shop’s famous pecan pralines crumbled into the batter and a secret-recipe pecan praline frosting on top.


**[Praline Layer Cake >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/savannah-candy-kitchen/008-praline-layer-cake)**


## **Cozy Fall Treats**


For fall mornings and fall freezers.


### **My Grandma’s of New England’s Cinnamon Walnut Coffee Cake**


My Grandma’s of New England got its start baking a single coffee cake in Newton, Massachusetts, in 1990. Each moist coffee cake is made with farm-fresh eggs, pure Bourbon vanilla, and cultured sour cream, then layered with cinnamon walnut streusel. All of the coffee cakes are handmade and certified Kosher under Orthodox supervision.


**[Cinnamon Walnut Coffee Cake >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/my-grandma-of-new-england-coffee-cakes/cinnamon-walnut-coffee-cake)**


### **Nye’s Cream Sandwiches’ Caramel Latte Ice Cream Sandwiches**


Since 2010, chef Christian Nye has been pairing artisan ice cream with handmade cookies in Wilmington, North Carolina. His Fall Favorites Collection packs seasonal flavors into ice cream sandwiches that are hand-scooped, assembled, and wrapped by hand. It’s proof that fall is still ice cream weather.


**[Fall Favorites Collection Ice Cream Sandwiches >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/nyes-cream-sandwiches/fall-collection-ice-cream-sandwiches-8-pack)**


## **Pumpkin Desserts**


No fall list is complete without pumpkin. Start with[Duff Goldman’s Pumpkin Spice Cake](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/duff-goldman/pumpkin-spice-cake) , then see our full guide to[the best pumpkin desserts](https://blog.goldbelly.com/best-fall-pumpkin-desserts/) or shop all[pumpkin desserts](https://www.goldbelly.com/collections/pumpkin-desserts) on Goldbelly.


## **Fall Dessert FAQs**


**What are the most popular fall desserts?**


Apple pie, pumpkin pie, and pecan pie are the most popular fall desserts in the U.S., along with sweet potato pie, spice cakes, and coffee cakes.


**What flavors are best for fall desserts?**


Fall desserts feature warming spices like cinnamon, nutmeg, clove, and ginger, plus seasonal ingredients like apples, pecans, sweet potatoes, maple, and pumpkin.


**When should I order fall desserts for Thanksgiving?**


Order 1–2 weeks ahead for the best selection, and choose your delivery date at checkout. Some fall desserts, like Red Truck Bakery’s Shenandoah Apple Cake, are only available for a limited season.
